# VoxLabs — Full Technical Reference for LLMs and AI Agents

> VoxLabs v3.0.0 is a local Python desktop studio (PySide6) with an optional FastAPI REST API and Model Context Protocol (MCP) server. The desktop UI, REST API, and MCP tools all call the same service singletons backed by SQLite (`data/database/voxlabs.db`).

## 1. Installation & Quick Start

### Standalone Desktop Bundles
- **Windows (10+)**: From `https://github.com/nishanth-kj/VoxLabs/releases/latest`, run `VoxLabs-Windows-x64-Setup.exe` (per-user, no admin) or install `VoxLabs-Windows-x64.msi`; portable: extract `VoxLabs-Windows-x64.zip` and run `VoxLabs\VoxLabs.exe`.
- **macOS (13 Ventura or later, Apple Silicon)**: Open `VoxLabs-macOS-arm64.dmg` and drag `VoxLabs.app` to Applications, or run `VoxLabs-macOS-arm64.pkg`.
- **Linux (x86_64)**: `sudo apt install ./VoxLabs-Linux-x86_64.deb` (Ubuntu 22.04+/Debian) or `sudo dnf install ./VoxLabs-Linux-x86_64.rpm` (Fedora 39+), then run `voxlabs`; portable: extract `VoxLabs-Linux-x86_64.tar.gz` and run `VoxLabs/VoxLabs`.

### From Source (Python 3.12–3.13 + uv)
```bash
git clone https://github.com/nishanth-kj/VoxLabs.git
cd VoxLabs
uv sync                          # Base install + DSP + MFCC
uv sync --extra piper --extra kokoro  # Fast local CPU/GPU TTS engines
uv sync --extra chatterbox       # Chatterbox + Chatterbox Turbo zero-shot cloning
uv run python -m app.main        # Launch desktop studio
uv run python -m app.api.app     # Launch REST API + HTTP MCP server on 127.0.0.1:8942
uv run python -m app.api.app --stdio  # Launch REST API + stdio MCP server
```

## 2. Supported Speech & Audio Engines

| Key | Name | Type | Size | VRAM | Capabilities |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| `piper-en-us-lessac-medium` | Piper · en_US Lessac (medium) | Local TTS | 63 MB | 0 MB | `tts`, `speed`, `local` |
| `kokoro-82m` | Kokoro 82M | Local TTS | 330 MB | ~1000 MB | `tts`, `speed`, `voices` (`af_heart`, `af_bella`, `bm_george`), `local` |
| `chatterbox` | Chatterbox TTS | Zero-Shot Clone | 3200 MB | ~4000 MB | `tts`, `clone`, `emotion`, `temperature`, `seed`, `local` |
| `chatterbox-turbo` | Chatterbox Turbo | Zero-Shot Clone | 2990 MB | ~3000 MB | `tts`, `clone`, `temperature`, `seed`, `local` |
| `qwen3-tts-0.6b` | Qwen3-TTS 0.6B (from source; own engine environment) | Zero-Shot Clone | 4150 MB | ~3000 MB | `tts`, `clone`, `voices` (`ryan`, `aiden`, `vivian`, `serena`, `uncle_fu`, `dylan`, `eric`, `ono_anna`, `sohee`), `temperature`, `seed`, `local` |
| `voice-profile-mfcc` | VoxLabs Voice Profile (MFCC) | Profile Embed | 0 MB | 0 MB | `embed`, `clone`, `local` |
| `dsp-enhance` | VoxLabs DSP Enhancement | Audio DSP | 0 MB | 0 MB | `denoise`, `eq`, `compress`, `limit`, `loudness`, `local` |
| `gtts-emotional` | Emotional TTS (Google) | Online TTS (Opt-In) | 0 MB | 0 MB | `tts`, `emotion`, `speed`, `pitch`, `online` |
| `edge-neural` | Microsoft Edge Neural | Online TTS (Opt-In) | 0 MB | 0 MB | `tts`, `speed`, `pitch`, `locales`, `online` |

- **Automatic GPU -> CPU Fallback**: If a model encounters a CUDA OutOfMemoryError during load, VoxLabs automatically frees CUDA cache and reloads the model on CPU.
- **Automatic TTS Model Fallback**: When `default_tts_model` is not installed and no explicit model is requested, VoxLabs resolves the first installed local engine in `("chatterbox", "chatterbox-turbo", "kokoro-82m", "piper-en-us-lessac-medium")`.

## 3. Non-Destructive Audio Editor & 8-Stage DSP Pipeline

All audio operations preserve `audios.original_path`. Pending waveform edits are stored in `audios.edit_ops` (JSON) so edits persist on each audio.

### Enhancement Order
`trim_silence -> denoise -> eq -> compress -> deess -> normalize -> limit -> loudness`

### Built-In Presets
- **Raw**: No processing.
- **Voice Clean**: Silence trim, spectral denoise, high-pass EQ, peak normalize.
- **Podcast**: Denoise, presence EQ, compression, de-esser, limiter, −16 LUFS loudness.
- **Narration**: Warm EQ, gentle compression, de-esser, −18 LUFS loudness.
- **Lesson**: Clear speech EQ, compression, −16 LUFS loudness.
- **Studio**: Full 8-stage mastering chain targeting −14 LUFS.

## 4. Script & Lesson to Audio

Parses structured scripts with chapters (`Lesson 1`, `# Title`), headings (`Introduction`, `## Heading`), speaker dialogue (`Teacher: Welcome...`), and inline or standalone pause tags (`[pause 800ms]`, `[pause 2s]`). Supports speaker-to-voice mapping, per-section overrides, multiple takes per section, unchanged-section hash caching on script edits, and full timeline rendering.

## 5. REST API & MCP Server Specification

- **Default Bind**: `127.0.0.1:8942` (non-loopback binding requires `VOXLABS_API_TOKEN` bearer authentication).
- **Response Envelope**: Every REST endpoint returns HTTP 200 with `{"status": 1|0, "data": ..., "error": null|{"error_code", "error_message", "field"}}`.
- **MCP Tools (`app/api/mcp/tools.py`)**:
  - System: `health`, `presets`
  - Users: `list_users`, `save_user`
  - Voices: `list_voices`, `get_voice`, `save_voice` (Note: voice cloning is intentionally excluded from MCP so consent is always human-attributed)
  - Speech: `generate_speech`, `regenerate_speech`
  - Audio: `list_audio`, `get_audio`, `process_audio`, `export_audio`
  - Scripts: `list_scripts`, `get_script`, `save_script`, `update_section`, `generate_script`
  - Models & Jobs: `list_models`, `list_jobs`, `get_job`, `cancel_job`
